o1: Predicted to enable actin filament binding activity and microfilament motor activity. Enables actin-dependent ATPase activity. Involved in locomotion; nematode larval development; regulation of embryonic cell shape; and embryonic body elongation. Is located in adherens junction and contractile muscle fiber. Is expressed in several structures, including lateral epidermal cells; anal depressor muscle; head; hypodermis; reproductive system; and tail. Is part of the let-502/Rho-binding kinase and mel-11/myosin phosphatase pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including auditory system disease (multiple); autosomal dominant Alport syndrome; blood platelet disease (multiple); end stage renal disease; and megacystis-microcolon-intestinal hypoperistalsis syndrome. Orthologous to several human genes including MYH11 (myosin heavy chain 11).
